column1: # Level-up perks (Corne 15 Oct: "skills you can get... you build up as you play"). Kills give xp (the enemy's base
# score); each level needs xp_base x xp_growth^(level-1). On level-up the game pauses and offers 3 different
# perks (weighted, seeded); pick 1. stat = the player modifier it adds to; amount is added per stack.
